description: This file defines error listener interfaces and implementations for the ANTLR parser generator, including default, console, and proxy error listeners.

classes.name: ErrorListener
classes.description: Interface defining methods for error listeners in ANTLR.

classes.name: DefaultErrorListener
classes.description: Default implementation of ErrorListener with no-op methods.

classes.name: ConsoleErrorListener
classes.description: Error listener that outputs syntax errors to standard error.

classes.name: ProxyErrorListener
classes.description: Error listener that delegates calls to multiple other ErrorListeners.

methods.name: NewDefaultErrorListener
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DefaultErrorListener.

methods.name: NewConsoleErrorListener
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ConsoleErrorListener.

methods.name: NewProxyErrorListener
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ProxyErrorListener with specified delegate listeners.
